page.overview:
Who is Flavi?

Flavi is a traveler who can be found in . She sleeps in the during the night.

When speaks to her, Flavi remarks on the weather, the warmth being nice when compared to the heat of the . She then asks if Link is visiting Lurelin on vacation. If Link asks about the Desert, Flavia explains that she's from , which is surrounded by the Desert.

Flavi came to Lurelin Village out of interest in . During the day, she camps out on a hill just outside of the village and looks upon the Island. However, she's had difficulties in reaching it by sea and wonders if one needs wings to reach it.

During the rain, Flavi takes shelter under the umbrellas outside the Fishing Resort. When Link speaks to her during this time, she admits to hating the rain as it makes her miss home. If Link says he likes the rain, she calls him a weirdo. It never rains in Gerudo Town, so while she was initially intrigued by it, it now annoys her.
